sentences.en: The locomotive was pulling a long line of freight cars.

sentences.en: "Which line should I get in?" "Any line is fine."

sentences.en: Is there any good way to memorise our lines quickly?
sentences.zh: 有没有什么快速记忆台词的好方法？
